title: The Truth of the Shackles
next_chapter_hook: Just as Chen Ji was struggling to digest this earth-shattering truth, the Tianji Record's main body suddenly flickered, and a coordinate seared itself into the depths of his mind—the Tianji Pavilion Headquarters, deep within that forbidden land, where the seventh page of the Tianji Record awaited its true master.

text.content: The excruciating pain receded like the tide, and Chen Ji knelt in a pool of blood, feeling utterly hollowed out. Ten years of lifespan—what a heavy price—among the strands of his hair, a few whites had quietly appeared. Just then, a brilliant golden light suddenly burst forth from the void, illuminating the entire secret chamber as bright as day.

A towering figure like a mountain materialized within the golden light, and Chen Ji's pupils constricted—it was an ancient book exuding primordial chaos, with seven mystical runes flowing across its surface, each carrying an overwhelming pressure that could shift the very heavens and earth. The Tianji Record's main body had descended.

dialogue.content: "Chess player of destiny, do you know that every act of foresight pushes you deeper into the abyss?" The Tianji Record's voice was ancient and authoritative, like the sound of the Great Dao exploding beside one's ear. "The shackles are never as simple as you imagined."

text.content: Chen Ji forced himself to stand, his gaze like iron: "I saw it—the Heavenly Fate Keys, my sister, the Tianji Pavilion's layout, countless pawns manipulated by you!" His voice carried fury. "So tell me, what is the true nature of the shackles!"

The Tianji Record's main body slowly unfurled, all seven mystical runes illuminating simultaneously, and an information torrent flooded into Chen Ji's mind like a deluge. His complexion instantly turned deathly pale—that was no ordinary knowledge, but memory fragments from countless generations of Tianji Record users, a history written with blood and tears.

dialogue.content: "The shackles were forged by the first generation of Tianji Pavilion members with their own hands." That voice was ice-cold and merciless. "They discovered the price of the Tianji Record—every glimpse of the future, the user's lifespan, fortune, and even soul would be devoured by fate."

text.content: Chen Ji saw a broken memory—in that distant era, a spirited young man obtained the first page of the Tianji Record. He foresaw the future and dominated the world, yet ultimately met the fate of lamp oil exhausted and soul scattered. And his grieving kinfolk established the Tianji Pavilion.

dialogue.content: "The founders of the Tianji Pavilion thought they had found the method of immortality—as long as they gathered enough Tianji Record fragments, they could share the burden and delay their demise." The Tianji Record's voice carried mockery. "Ridiculously, they themselves were merely chess pieces in fate's grand game."

text.content: The memories continued flowing. Chen Ji witnessed the rise and fall of the Tianji Pavilion—every generation's inheritor pursued the complete Tianji Record, and every generation met the same tragic end. They thought they were controlling fate, unaware they had long been toyed with by beings of higher order between heaven and earth.

"The Heavenly Celestial Eye..." Chen Ji suddenly raised his head, fury blazing in his eyes. "Is that the mastermind behind all this?" The Tianji Record fell silent for a moment before finally giving the answer: "It is not the mastermind, but the rule itself. It needs no conspiracy, for it is the Heavenly Dao."

dialogue.content: "The Tianji Record is me, the Tianji Pavilion is me, and the Heavenly Celestial Eye is also me." These words exploded like thunder in Chen Ji's mind. "I am the chess piece collector Heaven has placed in this world, and you—"

text.content: "—are the only anomaly among all past users who has the chance to break the rules." The Tianji Record's voice carried complex emotions for the first time. "The shackles are not a fetter, but protection. Before you gain sufficient strength, they prevent you from being completely devoured by fate."

choice.prompt: The truth of the shackles was this残酷, yet the method to break destiny was only one—to obtain all seven pages of the Tianji Record and rewrite the rules. Chen Ji, how will you choose?

choices.description: Since the shackles are protection, one should accelerate the collection of the seven pages of the Tianji Record even more, rewrite the rules of fate, and liberate all those being manipulated.
choices.visible_cost: Continue consuming Heavenly Fate, lifespan further shortened
choices.visible_reward: Possibility of rewriting Heavenly Dao rules with the power of the complete Tianji Record
choices.risk_hint: The Heavenly Celestial Eye will never stand by idly, must proceed with careful strategy

text.content: A resolute light flashed in Chen Ji's eyes: "Since Heaven intends to use us as chess pieces, I shall overturn this chessboard!" His voice echoed through the void, carrying unyielding will. The Tianji Record's main body trembled slightly, seemingly satisfied with this answer.

choices.text: Negotiate with the Heavenly Celestial Eye
choices.description: Since the Tianji Record, Tianji Pavilion, and Heavenly Celestial Eye are one entity, perhaps there's a possibility to negotiate with this ultimate existence, trading some price for true freedom.
choices.visible_cost: May lose partial freedom or have new restrictions implanted
choices.visible_reward: May gain a brief period of safety and more intelligence
choices.risk_hint: Negotiating with a tiger, extremely dangerous

text.content: Chen Ji suddenly laughed, that smile carrying a tranquility of having seen through everything: "Since you are the rules, I shall play chess against the rules." His eyes flickered in the darkness, like ghostly flames burning in the abyss. The Tianji Record fell silent, for it knew this person was serious.

choices.description: Not operating within the rules, but directly challenging the structure of the Tianji Record itself. Using oneself as the catalyst, completely shattering this curse system that takes life as its price.
choices.visible_cost: May die on the spot, soul scattered
choices.visible_reward: If successful, will completely liberate all souls bound by the Tianji Record
choices.risk_hint: A path of certain doom with one chance in ten

text.content: "Rules are meant to be broken!" Chen Ji suddenly burst into laughter, that laughter carrying a mad delight. "Since the shackles are protection, I shall first break the protection, then use my own power to guard those I wish to protect!"

The Tianji Record's main body gradually dissipated, but its voice still echoed in Chen Ji's ears: "If you wish to break the rules, you must first possess the power of rules. The seven pages of the Tianji Record are scattered across the world—"

"The first page is in your hands, the second in the Tianqing Sect's secret realm, the third in the Holy Sect of the Demonic Path's forbidden grounds, the fourth in the Xuanwu Sect's ancestral land, the fifth in the Chen family's ancestral land, the sixth on Chen Nian..." Each name was like a heavy hammer striking Chen Ji's heart.

dialogue.content: "And the seventh page—" The Tianji Record's voice suddenly became grave. "Is deep within the Tianji Pavilion Headquarters. That forbidden land has never seen anyone enter alive since the Tianji Pavilion's founding."

text.content: The moment the Tianji Record completely dissipated, a golden light shot into Chen Ji's brow center—a coordinate, a position seared into the depths of his soul. His pupils contracted sharply: "The Tianji Pavilion Headquarters... wasn't that sealed by the three major sects long ago?"

choice.prompt: Chen Ji had obtained the location information for the seventh page of the Tianji Record, but the Tianji Pavilion Headquarters was a legendary forbidden land. Next, he had to make a decision.

choices.text: Go Immediately to the Tianji Pavilion Headquarters
choices.description: While the Heavenly Celestial Eye hasn't fully noticed, strike first, directly infiltrate the forbidden land to obtain the seventh page of the Tianji Record.
choices.visible_cost: May encounter unknown dangers, state not yet recovered
choices.visible_reward: If successful, will gain a critical breakthrough
choices.risk_hint: What terrifying entities lurk within the forbidden land, unknown

text.content: Chen Ji didn't hesitate, forcing his weak body to stand despite the lingering pain. He knew his current condition was far from good, but opportunities were fleeting—"Let's go!" His figure turned into a stream of light, rushing toward the direction of the Tianji Pavilion Headquarters.

choices.text: First Seek Advice from Su Qingyao
choices.description: The Tianji Pavilion Headquarters is extremely dangerous, going alone is by no means advisable. Su Qingyao is the Inner Disciple Senior Fellow and may know some intelligence about the forbidden land.
choices.visible_cost: Wastes time, may miss the best opportunity
choices.visible_reward: Gain Su Qingyao's support and intelligence, reduce risks

text.content: Chen Ji suppressed the urgency in his heart and turned toward Tianqing Sect. He knew that blind courage would only make him die faster—and he still had too many things unfinished, his sister not yet found, destiny not yet broken...

choices.text: Contact Ye Qing to Borrow Demonic Path Power
choices.description: The Holy Sect of the Demonic Path possesses the ability to conceal the Tianji Record's aura, perhaps helping him infiltrate the Tianji Pavilion Headquarters unnoticed by the Heavenly Celestial Eye.
choices.visible_cost: Will owe the Demonic Path a favor, may be required to repay
choices.visible_reward: Gain the cover of Demonic Path mist, reduce risk of discovery
choices.risk_hint: The Demonic Path's people cannot be fully trusted

text.content: A calculating light flickered in Chen Ji's eyes. Ye Qing, the Demonic Path's Saint Maiden, had cooperated with him before, and her abilities were exactly what he needed now. However, dealing with the Demonic Path was no different from negotiating with a tiger... "But I am no saint anyway." He coldly smiled.

Just as Chen Ji was contemplating, a cold voice came from the void: "Chess player of destiny, every step you take is within my sight." That was the voice of the Heavenly Celestial Eye, carrying an overwhelming pressure beyond all things, as if the entire heavens and earth were gazing down upon him.

Chen Ji suddenly raised his head, his eyes blazing with unyielding light: "What does it matter if you've seen it?" His voice was calm yet firm. "Since you are the rules, I shall play chess against Heaven with this mortal body!" His figure appeared so small within the golden light, yet so brilliant.
